technical_requirements: Index scale target: phase1 10M vectors, long-term 200M+ objects (vector dims 1536 typical).
Latency targets: p50 < 80ms (retrieval + rerank lightweight), p99 < 300ms for interactive UI; bulk analytic queries can be slower.
Throughput: sustained 200 qps for peak product hours, spiky bursts to 1k qps.
Cost sensitivity: target effective cost per end-user retrieval (including rerank elect) <= $0.005.
Vector DBs to evaluate: pgvector (already piloting), Pinecone (managed), Weaviate (self-managed), Elastic hybrid-search integration.
Connector requirements: incremental/streaming ingest, delta updates, backfill tooling, optimistic concurrency on embeddings, configurable batching, TTL/soft-delete, fanout to hybrid keyword index.
Reranking pattern: two-stage retrieval (vector recall) then cheap transformer reranker (distil or small encoder) for top-20, avoid full LLM unless confidence low.
Consistency requirements: near-real-time updates for critical legal edits (<60s), ability to tag sensitive docs and enforce residency rules per-index.
Observability: token-level cost breakdowns, per-route latency histograms, cache hit rates for prefix/KV caching, per-connector tracing.
Failover: automatic fallback path to smaller model hosted in dedicated tier when primary capacity constrained; graceful degradation acceptable.
poc_plan: Phase 0 (this month): security & legal checklist completion (SOC2 docs, KMS architecture).
Phase 1 (2 weeks): Ingest 100k documents from sample corpus into Redwood + pgvector connector; measure cold/warm p50/p99 retrieval latency and recall@10.
Phase 2 (4 weeks): Scale to 1M vectors with streaming updates; test peak QPS 200 with sustained load and reranker enabled; measure cost per query at target QPS.
Phase 3 (6-8 weeks): Run 10M+ production-like workload on Dedicated or Private; evaluate weaviate/pinecone tradeoffs and finalize connector SLA + ops runbook.
Success metrics: recall@10 >= 0.85 on canonical query set, p50/p99 under targets, cost per retrieval within budget, legal signoff on KMS + residency.
